answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: each new identity earns rewards that stay locked like ice in a glacier, thawing linearly over 30 epochs, and any slashed attestation burns the unvested remainder. A fork of 1,000 fake agents can't flash past like a comet and cash out; the attacker must fund every account for weeks while peers have time to flag the cluster. No identity is an island, so one caught clone forfeits the locked stake of its whole linked set.
